title: StarChat desktop edition
description: Build time settings of a desktop app built from StarChat. See docs/desktop.md.

appName.description: Name in window titles, the installer, the start menu and in chat texts (:app).

appId.description: Reverse domain id of the app (Windows AppUserModelId, macOS bundle id).

executableName.description: Name of the installers, the install folder and the Linux program, lower case. On Windows and macOS the program is named after appName.

dataDir.description: Folder in the user's app data. Defaults to executableName. Keep it when an older app of yours used another folder, so profiles and logs stay.

formerDataDirs.description: Data folders of older versions of your app. When dataDir does not exist yet, the first of these that exists is used, so nothing has to be copied.

publisher.description: Shown as copyright and vendor in the installers.

icon.description: PNG with at least 512x512 pixels, path relative to the edition folder. The Windows icon is made from it.

splashImage.description: Image on the start screen, relative to the edition folder. Defaults to the icon.

primaryServer.description: Domain of the network of your edition: a "Home Server" tab, the first connection and the API for login and features come from it. Leave it out for a client without a preset network.

networkName.description: Name of the primary network in tabs and the connections list (:network in texts). Defaults to primaryServer.

serverList.description: 'default', an https URL of an own list, or false for the primary server only.

themeCss.description: CSS file loaded after the bundled theme, relative to the edition folder.

modules.description: Names of the feature modules to ship. All bundled ones when left out.

texts.description: Texts that replace bundled ones, per language and key. Keys of the chat (src/i18n) and of the app (desktop/locales).

updates.description: Where the app looks for new versions. Without it the app does not update itself.

chatBundles.description: Signed chat updates without a new installer. Off when left out.

publicKey.description: PEM file with the ECDSA P-256 public key, relative to the edition folder.
